en: Mmm... something is definitely\nwrong, Captain.

Good work, Captain. I thought
we were supposed to be
arriving at the next planet
soon, but are we running late?

We need to resupply our food,
and I was hoping we could do a
little sightseeing while we're
out shopping...
Ah, Fayt, Rena. Actually...

Eh? What do you mean the
ship isn't moving? We're
making progress right now,
aren't we?

Yes, the ship is moving
forward. However, once we
reach a certain point, we end
up returning to the same
coordinates.
That's impossible... It's not like\nwe're at the edge of a screen\nin some early-era RPG.

I believe those TV games are
from more than 800 years
before your time, Fayt... How
do you know so much about
them?
Retro games have a certain\ndepth to them. I've been quite\ninto them lately.

A-anyway, at first I suspected
an instrument malfunction... but
it seems the cause lies within
this sector, "<font color=yellow>Starbirth</font>".

The Starbirth sector...? A place
where stars are born. It
certainly feels like a place
where anything could happen...
Whoa, what was that?! Did the\nship hit something?

No way, that's impossible!
There shouldn't have been any
celestial bodies nearby for us
to collide with...!
Waaaaah!! The external\ncameras and sensors aren't\nworking at all!!

You're right. Looks like we have
no choice but to go check it
out ourselves. Captain, I'm
coming with you.
Oh, I'm coming too! Coro,\nplease stay here and continue\ninvestigating the cause.
Wh-what is this...!?
Eve: I'll shine as bright as a\ntwinkling star!
Audience: Ooooooh!! Eve! Eve!
Don't you dare blink, my friend!
Come on, dance with me!
Audience: Ooooooh!! Our very\nown Milky Quintet!

A Milky Quintet live
performance!? Wh-when did
this even happen!? And what is
everyone doing!?
Why is Sophia here...? And why\nis Eve on that stage!? She's\nsupposed to be...!

Fayt! The Eve up there isn't
the real Eve. And of course,
neither am I, nor Miki and the
others.
Sophia! Why are you behind\nme...!? What on earth is going\non...?
Thank you everyone for the\nenergy! Now then, I wonder\nwhat the results will be?
Audience: OOOOOOH!! Eve! Eve!\nOur Milky Quintet!
...Only Eve stayed on stage!?
...Is it because of the Idol\nAudition image?
Come on, Chairperson! What\nare the results!?

Chairperson: An idol making
such a scary face? Non, non~.
Come on, come on, Smile,
smiiiile♪
That! Could it be Givel!!
I-it feels... like the atmosphere\nis quite different from before...
Chairperson: Well then, I shall\nannounce the results of this\nAudition!
Chairperson: Too bad! Once\nagain, no galaxy-class idol star\nhas been born!
Aaaah... Nooo!

Chairperson: And with that, the
Starbirth famous Idol Audition
is officially over! Please look
forward to the next one! ♪

Eve, that strange Givel... and
even the audience that was
there just now has all
vanished...?

Captain, I get it! In this sector,
human spirits and memories
seem to exert a strong
influence on the space around
us.

To the point where intense
human emotions take shape as
manifestations of residual
thoughts...
...Yeah. I just saw it. A sight\nwhere residual thoughts had\ntaken form.
You don't mean that stage just\nnow was... Eve's residual\nthoughts? No, that can't be!
...I have a feeling that's the\ncase too.
Eve looked so happy when we\nwere all performing together.
Yeah, we shouldn't linger. We\nhave to go find the real Eve,\nnot these residual thoughts.

True. Those residual thoughts
are concerning, but they've
vanished for now. We must find
an escape route quickly...
Wh... Wha-?! Everyone, this is\nbad! Not just the coordinates,\nbut time... time is rewinding!
...What...!? You mean...!

Chairperson: Shine bright!
Starbirth's famous Idol
Audition! Sorry to keep you
waiting, kittens! It's that time of
the week again! ♪
Eve's Residual Thought: Entry\nnumber one! Milky Quintet!\nHere we go!
Audience: Ooooooh!! Eve! Eve!\nOur Milky Quintet!
The vanished Eve and the\nothers have reappeared...?\nWhat is going on!?
Not just the location, but time\nitself is looping around in\ncircles...?
It's almost as if Eve's residual\nthoughts are crying out, "Don't\nleave us behind..."

And so, the real Milky Quintet,
now known as Milky Quartet, is
reuniting with just the four of
us!
We can't afford to lose to the\nfake Milky!

I see, so since this place is an
audition venue, you've decided
to just go for it and
participate.

Yeah, if we perform
passionately like before, maybe
even Eve's lingering thoughts
will be satisfied... meow!
That sloppy way you end your\nsentences, Sophia... how\nnostalgic.
Nngh! I feel it... it's almost time.

Chairperson: Shine bright!
Starbirth's famous Idol
Audition! Sorry to keep you
waiting, kittens! It's that time of
the week again! ♪

Chairperson: Now then, let's
start right away with our
challengers! Come on, come on,
step right up onto the stage!
Alright, let's go everyone. Let's\nput all our feelings into our\nsong...!
Chairperson: You're\ndisqualified.
Ah, wh-what...? I can't dance as\nwell as before, and my voice\nwon't come out...!

It's because you haven't
practiced much lately. The
performing arts will surely
wither if you don't keep at
them...

Compared to them, Eve and
the others are the most
brilliant quintet in Eve's
memories. W-we can't win...

But there's no reason why the
real thing should lose to a
memory of the past. We have
to do something...

Chairperson: Those who fail
must promptly leave the
stage... And for naughty little
kittens who cannot follow the
rules...
Chairperson: You'll get a\npunishment!!!
Kyaaaaaah!!!
Are you okay, Sophia?!
I'm fine. Thank you, Fayt...

You don't have to make that
face. If we're lacking practice,
then we'll just practice. We
have plenty of time, so...

...After participating in the
Audition, I can't help but feel
that we just aren't good
enough to pass...

If even the phantom of us at
our peak, led by Eve, couldn't
pass this Audition, then the
four of us with so little
practice...

Furthermore, judging by Givel's
behavior, Eve's lingering
thoughts seem to be
stubbornly protecting this
memory.

Perhaps she couldn't pass the
Audition, and so she wishes for
this live performance to
continue forever...

Yeah... maybe the Eve standing
on that stage is just a happy
memory that the current Eve
has cast aside.
Just constantly reminiscing\nabout happy memories... it\nmust be boring, and so sad.

...Yes. It's all within one
person's memory, with no one
to share it. At this rate, she'll
be alone for tens of thousands
of years...
Coro, could you pick out an idol\noutfit for me? I want to try\nparticipating in the Audition.
Ehh?! Fayt?

Can I try too? The phantom
stage, the phantom comrades...
I want to save Eve, who keeps
performing all alone in there.
Being all alone is so painful...
Rena...

Understood! Based on every
single piece of information in
my database, I will prepare the
galaxy's greatest idol outfit!

So this is my idol outfit. It's a
little embarrassing... but it's
better to just go all out with
this kind of thing.
How's this?
Kyaaaah!!! Fayt, you look\namazing!!!
What do you think of my\noutfit?

Whoa! Rena, you're so cute
too!! Wait, can you actually ride
that crescent-shaped
machine?
Yes, it's the Crescent Flip.\nVerda made it for me so I can\nperform using the whole stage.
Mufufu, even I must admit, it\nwas a brilliant idea!

Now that we've checked the
costumes, let's start with voice
training. I'm going to be strict,
so be prepared!
Fayt & Rena: Yes, ma'am!
Phew...
You look quite exhausted.

Being an idol is hard work. I
use different muscles than in
battles or basketball, so I'm all
sore. Ow, ow, ow...

Back when I was in Faykreed, I
tried my hand at sword
dancing, and I remember
feeling just like you do now,
Fayt.
I guess that's just what\nhappens when you take on\nsomething new.

But the harder the challenge,
the greater the sense of
accomplishment when you
conquer it.
Just like in a game.
Haha, true! For our sake and\nfor Eve's sake, we can't just\nspend all our time resting.
Alright, just watch me, Fidel. I'm\ngoing to try it all the way\nthrough!
Phew... How was that, Fidel?
I don't know much about\nsinging or dancing, but...
Fayt... are you perhaps feeling\na little embarrassed?
Ah... so you could tell?

Yeah, your movements got
smaller during the climax, and
your eyes were darting around,
so I figured that might be why.
I knew you'd notice... It's not\nthat I'm lying about wanting to\nbecome an idol to save Eve...
It's just, once I actually try\ndoing it, I get more and more\nembarrassed.
But I guess there's no way\naround it; I have to overcome\nthis myself.
In that case, how about trying\nto fully immerse yourself in the\n"Idol" character?
I'm not an actor, so it's not\nthat easy.
But I think you have talent,\nFayt...
What do you mean?

I mean, when you get serious
playing games, you always get
into character and shout out
your special move names, don't
you?
...Huh?
Oh, wait... You hadn't noticed?
N-No way... Have I been\nunconsciously acting like a\nhormonal teenager...?!
I-It's okay! Everyone\nunderstands that's just how it\nis!
...So it's not just you, Fidel... I've\nbeen showing that side of\nmyself to everyone...

D-Don't be so depressed!! I
think it's a talent that'll be
really useful... C-Come on, let's
get back to practicing!
Ah... Now I'm starting to feel\nseriously embarrassed...

Sophia is one thing, but I
wonder what Cliff and Maria
think when they see me singing
and dancing...
No, Albel probably looks at me\nwith the coldest eyes\nimaginable...!
Fayt! Everyone knows the\ncircumstances, so it's fine!!

Oh, come to think of it, Reimi
and the others' idol personas
became famous across
planets...
On the day my idol persona\nleaks onto the internet and my\nfriends from university see it...
Ah... I can't take it... I can't bear\nit...

I messed up in the exact same
spot again... I just can't get the
choreography before the
chorus to flow smoothly...
Rena, why don't you take a\nlittle break? I brought some\ndrinks.
Thank you, Ilia. But I'm still\nokay for now.
(...I can't take a break until I've\nmastered this part...)
(Alright, one more time!)
Wait, don't stop the music, Ilia!\nI'm still practicing!!
Rena, even idols need rest. If\nyou push yourself too hard,\nnothing will go right.
But I can't just give up while\nI'm still struggling...
Resting and giving up are two\ncompletely different things.
Here, just have a drink for now.
Then, close your eyes and\nthink about something other\nthan singing and dancing.
...My head is so full of the\nAudition right now. I can't even\nthink about anything else...
Then we'll just have to force\nyou to. Come on, first, close\nyour eyes.

Now, what should we think
about? ...For example, "I want
to eat steak for dinner
tonight~" or something...

If it's steak, I bet Claude would
be happy... I wouldn't mind
sharing a slice or two with
him...
Hehe...

Did you just picture Rena's
face as she happily stuffs her
cheeks? Speaking of which, I
wonder what Claude is doing
right no―
...Hey! Why is it always about\nClaude!?
Oh, did you not like that?
No, it's not that I didn't like it,\nit's just...
So, how are you feeling now?
Ah...
Don't you feel like you could\nactually nail that choreography\nyou were stuck on earlier?
You're right! I feel like my head\nhas cleared!
That's proof you've properly\nrefreshed yourself! I'm glad.

I don't know much about idols,
but when my research stalls, I
try to relax and think about
something else.

When I do, a new perspective
often brings a solution out of
nowhere, making me wonder
why I was even worrying in the
first place.

You're right, Ilia! I think I
messed up that step earlier,
which is why I couldn't get the
rhythm right...
Is that so? The world of idols\nis quite deep. I didn't\nunderstand it at all.

Would you watch me? I'll try
dancing through the whole
thing! I want to show you a
perfect dance, Ilia!

How many days has it been
since Fayt and Rena first
attempted the Audition? They
try, they fail, they try, they
fail...
There was even that time they\nfailed so spectacularly they got\npunished!

...Well, the two of them are
receiving better evaluations as
time goes on. Let's keep our
hopes up for this time.
Time is turning back... Now, the\nAudition begins again. Let's\npass today for sure!
No matter how many times I\nexperience this, I still get\nnervous before it starts...

The way to relieve tension that
Ilia taught me was to write the
character for "person" on my
palm and then swallow...
Last time, it felt like we were\njust one step away...

I got too comfortable thinking
things were going well, and I let
my guard down and messed up
at the very end...
And I failed right at the start\nbecause of nerves...

Fayt, would it not be better to
perform as a team rather than
Rena and you performing
solos?

That's a great idea! That
should help ease the tension,
and any mistakes won't stand
out as much!
No. I don't think we can pass\nthis Audition that way.
You're right, Rena. I agree with\nyou.
And why not? A team can pull\noff much flashier\nperformances.
Eve, who is staying in this land,\nperforms on stage as Milky\nQuintet, but she is all alone.
Being with those illusions might\neven be deepening her\nloneliness.
That's why we, her rivals, have\nto face that loneliness and\novercome it.
Even though I was so close to\nEve, I failed to notice such a\nthing...
Sometimes, being close is\nexactly why you can't see it.
That's why all of us in\nGFSS-3214F help each other\nand move forward together.
Verda, and everyone in Milky\nQuartet, leave this to us!
I will definitely free Eve, who\nremains in this place, from her\nloneliness!!

Head Judge: Shine bright!
Starbirth's famous Idol
Audition! Sorry to keep you
waiting, kittens! It's time for our
weekly show! ♪
Come on, let's go.

Yeah. This time, we're definitely
passing, and we'll free Eve's
lingering thoughts from this
place!
Chairperson: Oh my, Milky\nQuintet. What's wrong? You've\nstopped singing~?

Chairperson: For a naughty
little kitten who stops singing
when her fans are waiting... she
deserves a punishment...
...Eve?
I wonder what's wrong? It's like\nshe's waiting for something...
Fayt, this is...!
Yeah! Now's the time!
Let's step forward, into the\nworld of dreams!
We won't stop! Nothing will\nchange if we just run away!

Chairperson: Ah! This is... an
intrusion! An intrusion! For a
naughty little kitten who
interrupts Evelysse's stage...
Eve's Residual Thought: Don't\nstop me, the live show isn't\nover yet!
Chairperson: Eh, ah, yes...
Audience: OOOOOOH!!

I knew it... While Eve's lingering
thoughts wish to remain as
they are, they're also searching
for something else.
This surge from the crowd... it's\nthe manifestation of that\nexpectation.
Now is the time! I want to\ndeliver my song to her!
My true self
I want to face it
I know I'll surely get hurt
But if I keep running away
Nothing will ever change
So I'll move forward

(Miss lingering thoughts of
Eve... no... Eve...! Can you hear
me? Is it reaching you? My
song, my feelings!)
Audience: OOOOOOH!!
Thank you for listening! ...Now\nit's your turn, Fayt!
Yeah, leave it to me! I'll make\nthem remember how exciting\nand fun the future can be!
These unchanging, boring\ndays...
I've had enough.
Let's break free.
From cowering in a tiny room,
And pretending to understand...

(Eve, even your lingering
thoughts must know. No matter
how many successful stages
we repeat, we'll never find joy
that surpasses our memories.)

(The infinite future of the story
we've stepped into... that's
what's truly exciting and full of
hope!)
Audience: OOOOOOH!!

Chief Judge: S-Stop! Don't
wreck the stage! Th-the
space... it's warping... Wh-what
a naughty little kitten... you are.
I won't let you get in our way!\nThis is our live show!
Eve, you can hear us, right?\nOur feelings. Please, answer\nus!!
Eve's Remnant: ...Rena, Fayt.\nThat was a truly wonderful\nstage.
Eve's Remnant: Reimi, Verda,\nMiki... Sophia... even the\nCaptain. Thank you, truly.
Eve's Remnant: I... I... also...
Eve...!

This is bad! Eve's remnant is
abandoning its existence in this
stagnant space! It's collapsing!!
Everyone, hurry back to the
ship!
Eve! Come with us!
Eve's Remnant: I am not your\nEve. There is an Eve waiting to\nbe brought back.
Even so, there's no way we're\nleaving you behind! Come on,\nreach out your hand!!
Eve's Remnant: Thank you... for\nshowing me hope... I was truly\nhappy...
Eve's Remnant: ...I'll... see you...\nin the future...

I'm glad everyone is safe. The
time and space anomalies have
vanished, so we can now
proceed to our original
destination.
That stage from before... it's\nvanished without a trace,\nhasn't it?

Rather than sinking into old
memories, I want to move
toward an infinite future. ...I'm
sure the Eve we know would
feel the same way.

That's why that stage of
memories fulfilled its purpose...
and vanished. That's what I
want to believe.
You're right. We have to move\nforward into the future!

This story has concluded. We
plan to release various other
stories in the future. Please
look forward to them.
